## Checklist
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint` pass; tests added or updated and passing
- [ ] No new permission (or the reason is explained above)
- [ ] No API keys, page content or personal data in code, tests, fixtures or logs
- [ ] `DesignScan` changes include a `schemaVersion` bump and a migration
- [ ] Generated prompts still contain no logos, brand names or page copy
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed
